snippet.title: Yokai Landlord: Monster Mystery! - Teaser trailer
snippet.description:
Scheduled to be released on Steam! Pre-registration is now open!

“Yokai Landlord: Monster Mystery!” is a Werewolf game-style social deduction adventure where you play as the landlord of an apartment and try to uncover the Yokai hiding among your residents.
In modern times, interpersonal relationships can be tenuous, but as the residents interact they slowly develop an understanding for one another...
Not just a mystery adventure, this is a heart-warming tale of character growth.

■Official YouTube Channel(@oyaoya-ooya3)
https://www.youtube.com/@oyaoya_ooya3
